editorial.blurb: Chercher is a genuine hole-in-the-wall gem serving authentic Ethiopian cuisine with deeply spiced, comforting dishes and a warm, welcoming atmosphere that honors the culture and care behind every plate.
editorial.insiderTip: Order a platter or sampler to experience multiple dishes family-style on injera; reservations are essential, especially on weekends, and don't miss the Mama Tej mead to complement the heavily spiced dishes.
